reason: The core card faithfully restates the pre-registered R15-A1 (4) table (CONTEXT l.2833-2853) and R15-A5: the V*_C conditions (COMPLETE, L_hi <= 9.0 h, display >= 0.955, other rung >= 0.954 or ERROR/unscored, 43=44 tie -> 44; the 'strictly above 42' clause is moot since D2 read exp70b 0.954), the (b)/(c) re-tick for the {#37,#38} world, the (a)/no/no-answer default, and the FREEZE. P(no V*_C) 0.75-0.85 matches R15-A1 (5) (P(>=1 at >=0.955) ~0.15-0.25). It adds no mechanism and needs no R8 path; a class-C final still needs the NEW user letter. Three defects, two material: (1) 'practically 12:00Z' is not the edge. The pre-registered edge is the first poll.log header with EITHER ref terminal, and ERROR is terminal at any latency (ledger.md: the upper bound is the first COMPLETE/ERROR seen). An early ERROR closes the pre-registration window before 12:00Z. (2) The '(b) + exp70b yes' branch is post-hoc and buggy. R15-A1 (4)(b) keeps 'the L9 insertion final', and exp70b is that only if 42 is L9 V*, which it is not (D2, 0.954 < 0.955). Substituting exp70b yields {V*_C, exp70b}: two public-selected K2+single-knob files (a DC threshold plus forkmid 4.5, and forkmid is on the closed list). That drops both the untuned anchor and the #38 insertion hedge, against the REASON text of (4). Its re-tick text 'untick 56563534, tick V*_C, keep exp70b' is also wrong when R16AP-2 deferred the exp70b re-tick to after the 43/44 read. #37 is then still ticked, and the result would be {#37, V*_C}, not the intended pair. (3) Minor: the one-line summary drops 'or unscored' and 'quote the ledger insertion-gate text' (the full card has them). VALUE: procedural only. A V*_C is a public-tuned threshold on one embryo, where display 0.955 is about one net division event. The only off-public evidence leans against transfer (6bba lab dc0.20: -0.0008, +6 FP forks, 0 TP; the dc0.30 lab/public sign flip). The recommended answer therefore stays (a).
fix: Keep the card with three edits. (1) Replace 'practically 12:00Z' with: 'log the letter with date -u the moment it arrives. It counts only if the last poll.log header at that time shows BOTH 56598763 and 56598765 PENDING; quote that header. An ERROR can close the window before 12:00Z.' (2) In (b), drop the exp70b substitution. Pre-registered (b) = {V*_C, #37 56563521}: untick 56563534, tick V*_C. If the user has ALSO said yes to exp70b, do not resolve this mechanically. Echo back the two options, {V*_C, #37} (pre-registered) or {V*_C, exp70b} (post-hoc, two public-tuned files, no untuned anchor, no insertion hedge), and have the user pick one. Write the full re-tick text from the CURRENTLY SELECTED refs read from the API: list which refs to untick and which to tick, so that the result is exactly two distinct COMPLETE refs. (3) Restore 'other rung >= 0.954 or ERROR/unscored' and 'quote the ledger insertion-gate text' in the summary. Keep (a) as the stated recommendation.
realistic_gain: About 0 on private in expectation. The card is procedural insurance against a mis-executed or post-hoc re-tick, not a score gain. If a V*_C exists (P ~0.15-0.25) and the user picks (b), the private delta vs {#37,#38} has an unknown sign and leans negative on the off-public evidence. The main value of the fixes is avoiding a wrong final pair in the (b)+exp70b branch and a mislabelled pre-registration after an early ERROR.
